Listen to this article Share … unveils full list of 40 oil, gas blocks Advertisement Advertisement The Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC) has opened the registration portal for the 2026 oil and gas licensing round, marking the official commencement of bidding for 40 hydrocarbon assets across the country. In a public notice on Saturday, the upstream regulator announced that the dedicated bid portal—br2026.gov.ng—went live on November 20, 2026, and will remain open for registration until January 15, 2027. The 40 blocks on offer span three distinct geological terrains, comprising 17 onshore assets, 14 shallow water blocks, and nine deep offshore acreages. Prospective investors can access the full list of available assets, regulatory guidelines, and frequently asked questions directly on the platform. According to the Commission, the bidding exercise will be executed in five structured phases: registration and prequalification, data access, submission of technical and commercial bids, technical evaluation, and a final commercial conference. Following the launch of the portal, the next major milestone in the bid calendar is a pre-bid conference scheduled to hold in Lagos on December 16, 2026, where the regulator is expected to engage prospective local and international investors on technical and fiscal expectations. Advertisement The 2026 licensing round was initially unveiled by the Commission Chief Executive on October 6, 2026, after securing statutory approval from President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, who also serves as the Minister of Petroleum Resources. The announcement was backed by statutory publications in local and international media in compliance with the provisions of the Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) 2021. Advertisement The NUPRC noted that ongoing updates regarding the round will be communicated via the bid portal and its official digital channels. Of the the total 40 blocks being offered, 17, including: PPL 2A 127, PPL 2A128, PPL 2A 129, PPL 2A 130, PPL 2A 131, PPL 2A 132, PPL 2A 133, PPL 2A 134, PPL 2A 135, PPL 2A 136, PPL 2A 140, PPL 2A 141, PPL 2A 142, PPL 2A 151, PPL 2A 152, PPL 2A 153, PPL 2A 154 are located onshore. Advertisement Advertisement The blocks on shallow waters include: PPL 2A 137, PPL 2A 138, PPL 2A 139, PPL 2A 143, PPL 2A 144, PPL 2A 145, PPL 2A 146, PPL 2A 147, PPL 2A 148, PPL 2A 149, PPL 2A 150, PPL 2A 155, PPL 2A 156, PPL 2A 157. Similarly, those on deep offshore include: PPL 303 – DO, PPL 305 – DO, PPL 3012, PPL 3018, PPL 3019, PPL 3020, PPL 3021, PPL 3022, PPL 3023.
